candidate_status: Existing Dream-RSI plus Pareto/Shinka policy in FORGE optimizerbridge is read-only advisory with independently pinned signed histories; no demonstrated causal prospective uplift on unseen structures.
hypothesis: A transfer-calibrated uncertainty-aware portfolio policy selects genuinely useful learned cognitive hypotheses better than the frozen Dream-RSI/Pareto selection policy at identical experiment and compute budgets, without optimizing gate counts.
novel_mechanism: Learn a counterfactual cross-task transfer score from independently qualified TRAIN-only research receipts: reward replicated unseen-family transfer / cost; penalize leakage, failed replication, false positives and structural-family regressions. Use frozen posterior uncertainty to select exploration versus exploitation; compare to existing Pareto/Dream policy using prospective randomized source-qualified assignments.

cohort.train_history: only accepted provenance-qualified read-only historical positives/negatives with source Git and independent evidence custody
cohort.prospective_assignment: same set of 20 independent sealed research proposal opportunities, precommitted randomization and propensities in existing signed selector audit, within each Wingless/Yggdrasil lane
cohort.holdout: independent prospective original sealed outcomes collected by owners under existing scientific rules, not writable by optimizer

controls: unchanged FORGE Dream-RSI and Shinka/Pareto frozen selector
cost-blind random allocation from same eligible pool

budgets.research_experiment_budget: identical total per arm and same sealed evaluators; reject unequal actual cost
budgets.optimizer_compute: new policy learning+scoring CPU <= original selector full computed CPU
budgets.optimizer_peak_memory: new policy including historical embedding cache <= original selector measured peak resident bytes

admission.primary: greater independently replicated unseen-relationship improvement per unit real compute on prospective randomized candidates, not win rate on historical synthetic fixtures; CI may pass with negative
admission.statistical_rule: paired per-opportunity cost-normalized effect interval excludes zero in favor of candidate, two independent independent scientific outcome audits and no family harm
admission.zero_leakage: record per-selection signed propensities, source pin, admission refs, exact output and negatives; halt on missing real randomized assignment provenance
admission.retention: intake original source-authenticated failures as failures via existing read-only optimizerbridge interfaces, never report as scientific successes
admission.promotion: separate protected scientific and operational authorization
